footer.ctaDescription: Open to opportunities in Creator Economy, Performance Marketing, and marketing leadership.

samsung-gaming.title: Gaming & Creator Economy
samsung-gaming.description: Full creator economy strategy for Samsung Gaming, connecting the brand to the gaming universe through influencers and performance content.
samsung-gaming.challenge: Samsung needed to position itself in the LATAM gaming market, competing with segment-native brands that already had a strong presence in the gaming community.
samsung-gaming.solution: We developed an integrated creator economy strategy, combining gaming influencers with performance campaigns and original content for digital platforms.
insights: Segment-native creators generate 3x more engagement than traditional celebrities
Co-created content with creators had 40% lower CPM than traditional ads
Always-on strategy outperformed one-off campaigns in awareness and conversion

heineken-creators.title: Creator Marketing & Events
heineken-creators.description: Creator marketing program for Heineken, integrating influencers into brand campaigns and live events to maximize reach and engagement.
heineken-creators.challenge: Heineken sought to rejuvenate its communication and connect with millennial and Gen Z audiences without losing the brand's premium essence.
heineken-creators.solution: We created a long-term creator program, integrating influencers at key brand moments such as festivals, launches, and seasonal campaigns.
insights: Long-term ambassador programs generate 2x more perceived authenticity
Integrating creators in live events amplifies social reach by 5x
Mix of micro and macro influencers optimizes campaign cost-effectiveness

redbull-content.title: Digital Content Strategy
redbull-content.description: Led the digital content strategy for Red Bull, creating a scalable content ecosystem with creators and platform-native formats.
redbull-content.challenge: Red Bull needed to scale its digital content production while maintaining the quality and authenticity that define the brand.
redbull-content.solution: We structured a content hub with specialized creators, producing platform-native content with an agile production system and clear performance metrics.
insights: Platform-native content generates 4x more engagement than adapted content
Creator hub reduces production costs by 60% compared to traditional agencies
Short formats (Reels/TikTok) had the highest organic sharing rate

airbnb-experiences.title: Creator Partnerships LATAM
airbnb-experiences.description: Creator partnership strategy for Airbnb Experiences in Latin America, connecting local hosts with influencers to boost bookings.
airbnb-experiences.challenge: Airbnb Experiences had low penetration in Latin America and needed to generate awareness and conversion simultaneously with limited budget.
airbnb-experiences.solution: We developed partnerships with travel and lifestyle creators in key LATAM markets, creating authentic content that connected local experiences with digital audiences.
insights: Local creators generate 3x higher conversion rate than adapted global campaigns
Authentic experience content had 5x higher ROI than traditional paid ads
Local SEO strategy combined with creator content increased organic traffic by 280%
